rules.name: 10-Point Lifestyle Compatibility Engine
rules.description: Calculates normalized percentage match (0-100%) between two flatmate profiles based on 10 lifestyle dimensions.

dimensions.notes: Heavy penalty if non-smoker meets regular smoker
Night owl vs early bird sleep intervals

rules.name: Room-to-Seeker Compatibility Scoring
rules.description: Evaluates fit between a seeker profile and an owner's room listing combining budget tolerance (+-20%), locality match (+30 pts), house rules alignment, and gender restriction.

rules.name: Free Connection Request Limit
rules.description: Unsubscribed seekers are limited to FREE_CONNECT_LIMIT = 5 outgoing connection requests. Upgrading to NestMate Pro or having a request declined refunds / unlocks connections.

rules.name: Contact Privacy & Phone Number Masking
rules.description: Phone numbers and WhatsApp direct messaging links are strictly masked. Unmasked contact data is stored in 'userContacts' subcollection and is readable ONLY by accepted connection partners or admins.

rules.name: 30-Day Listing Freshness & Discoverability Expiry
rules.description: Listings not reconfirmed by the owner within 30 days are automatically marked stale and excluded from the public marketplace until the owner clicks 'Confirm Still Available'.

rules.name: Tier 3 Owner Verification Gate
rules.description: Listings created by owners only display the verified shield badge once an admin reviews and approves uploaded ownership documents. Firestore rules forbid owners from setting ownerVerified: true themselves.

rules.name: Marketplace Role Separation Invariant
rules.description: Users with role === 'owner' are strictly excluded from the roommate discovery pool. Seekers cannot publish listings to the 'listings' collection.

rules.name: City & Locality Geolocation Resolution
rules.description: Every listing and seeker locality is assigned coordinates from the static Bangalore/city centroid matrix to calculate approximate distance in kilometers.

rules.name: Applicant Ranking & Fit Evaluation
rules.description: Owner dashboard sorts applicants by composite score: compatibility % (40%), profile completeness (20%), budget alignment (20%), and trust verification tier (20%).

rules.name: Seeker Onboarding Completeness Invariant
rules.description: Firestore security rules enforce that user profile documents for seekers MUST include quizAnswers with at least 5 completed answers (quizAnswers.size() >= 5).

rules.name: Listing Financial Invariants
rules.description: totalRent must be > 0, partnerShare must be > 0 and <= totalRent, deposit must be >= 0, and partnersNeeded must be >= 1.

rules.name: Single Active Role Invariant
rules.description: users/{uid}.role must be either 'seeker' or 'owner'. Switching roles requires an explicit profile update transaction.

rules.name: Self-Connection & Self-Report Prohibition
rules.description: Users cannot send connection requests to themselves (fromUserId != toUserId) and cannot file a report against their own account (reporterId != targetId).

rules.name: Active User Requirement for Mutating Operations
rules.description: Users with status === 'suspended' or 'deactivated' are denied write access to all collections (listings, connections, chat, reviews).

rules.name: Notification Immutability
rules.description: Notifications can be created by authenticated users (e.g. system alerts, connection notices) and read/deleted by the recipient, but their payload is immutable once created.

rules.name: Dual-Key Admin Access Model
rules.description: Admin privileges are granted if user.email matches the hardcoded whitelist OR if an active document exists in the 'admins/{email}' collection with role == 'admin'.

rules.name: Listing View Analytics
rules.description: Incrementing listing.views is rate-limited per user session to prevent artificial view inflation. Logged to listingViews collection with local calendar date.

rules.name: Chat Room Isolation
rules.description: Chat rooms and their nested messages are accessible ONLY by users listed in chatRoom.participants (or admins). Direct message writes require participant membership.

rules.name: Cascading Database Purge & Safe Wipe
rules.description: Safe purge deletes only documents with seed tags. Nuclear wipe deletes all 21 collections sequentially in batches and removes the current Auth account.

rules.name: City Alias Normalization
rules.description: Handles common colloquial spelling variations across Indian cities (e.g., 'Bangalore' -> 'Bengaluru', 'Bombay' -> 'Mumbai', 'Delhi' -> 'Delhi NCR').
